parties: Craftsman Automation Limited (issuer) | Axis Capital Limited (sole placement agent & bookrunning lead manager) | Qualified institutional buyers
headline: Craftsman Automation successfully raised ₹2,000 crore via QIP, placing 22,98,850 equity shares at ₹8,700 per share to institutional investors including HDFC MF, SBI MF, and HDFC Life.
sum: Craftsman Automation completed a ₹2,000 crore Qualified Institutions Placement on 18 June 2026, allotting 22,98,850 equity shares at ₹8,700 per share (2.97% discount to SEBI floor price of ₹8,966.13) to marquee institutional investors. The capital raise, approved by shareholders on 13 June 2026 and by the board on 16 May 2026, is intended for capacity expansion, working capital, and debt reduction in the company's high-growth precision engineering and automotive components segments.
implication: QIP pricing at 97% of floor price signals strong institutional demand for mid-cap engineering exporters with proven operational leverage; the deal structuring via accelerated placement (3-day subscription window, same-day allotment) reflects confidence in automotive supply-chain consolidation trends in EV and powertrain components, validating debt-to-equity recalibration strategies in capex-heavy industrial businesses.
detail: <cite index="18-1,18-3">Craftsman Automation successfully completed a Qualified Institutional Placement on 18 June 2026, raising approximately ₹2,000 crore through the allotment of 22,98,850 equity shares at ₹8,700 per share</cite>. <cite index="18-4">The issue price was offered at a 2.97% discount to the SEBI-prescribed floor price</cite>. <cite index="1-1">The company's Fund-Raising Committee approved the issuance on June 15, 2026, after shareholders authorised the broader fund-raise at an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) held on June 13, 2026</cite>. <cite index="42-10">HDFC Trustee Company Limited - HDFC Flexi Cap Fund was allotted 16.5% of the total issue size, SBI Multicap Fund received 6%, and HDFC Life Insurance Company was allotted 5%, among others</cite>.

structure.consideration: ₹2,000 cr (~₹199,999.95 lakhs) at ₹8,700 per share (issue price); ₹8,966.13 floor price (SEBI regulation 176 formula); 22,98,850 equity shares of face value ₹5 each
conditions: Shareholder special resolution approval at EGM held 13 June 2026 (>97% approval rate)
Board approval dated 16 May 2026 for fundraise up to ₹2,000 cr in one or more tranches
SEBI pricing formula compliance: floor price ₹8,966.13 per share (20-day VWAP avg method)
Discount cap of max 5% on floor price; final price determination by lead manager in consultation
Issue period opened 15 June 2026, closed 18 June 2026; allotment approved same day
Preliminary Placement Document filed with BSE & NSE on 15 June 2026
Trading window closure for insiders until 48 hours post-price determination
Regulatory filings with stock exchanges disclosing allottee details and investor composition
approvals: Fund-Raising Committee approval (15 June 2026 for launch; 18 June 2026 for allotment)
BSE & NSE listing compliance (preliminary placement document acceptance)
Axis Capital placement agency mandate (as sole bookrunning lead manager)
structure.novel: Accelerated 3-day subscription window (15–18 June) with same-day allotment reflects high institutional demand and procedural efficiency; pricing at ~97% of floor price (2.97% discount) signals strong market appetite despite volatility; major institutional cornerstone investors (HDFC MF 16.5%, SBI MF 6%, HDFC Life 5%) indicate confidence in capex-driven expansion thesis in automotive/EV supply chain.

triggers.note: Shareholder special resolution mandatory for preferential/QIP issuance of equity; mandates minimum notice, voting rights, pass threshold
QIP floor price must be set per statutory formula (higher of 20-day VWAP or 2-year average); triggers pricing gate & discount cap (max 5%)
Material event disclosure requirement triggers BSE/NSE filings at each stage: board approval → shareholder resolution → launch → allotment
Trading window closure triggered for designated persons from intimation date until 48 hours post-price determination; standard insider-trading compliance gate
Foreign Portfolio Investor participation in QIP subject to FPI registration and sectoral caps; triggers upstream KYC & reporting if offshore institutional buyers participate

timeline.t: Board of Directors approves fundraise of up to ₹2,000 cr in one or more tranches via equity, debt, QIP, ADR/GDR, or other eligible securities
EGM held; shareholders approve special resolution authorizing ₹2,000 cr fundraise (>97% approval); voting via video conference/OAVM
Fund-Raising Committee approves QIP launch; sets ₹8,966.13 floor price per SEBI ICDR regulation 176 formula; Preliminary Placement Document filed with BSE & NSE; trading window closure for insiders
QIP subscription period opens for eligible qualified institutional buyers

QIP subscription period closes; Fund-Raising Committee approves allotment of 22,98,850 equity shares at issue price ₹8,700 per share (2.97% discount to floor); paid-up capital increases from ₹11.93 cr to ₹13.08 cr
Stock trading resumes; shares up 3–4% on market confidence; paid-up equity capital and share count disclosed to stock exchanges
Bar & Bench article published detailing law firm teams and transaction structure
